sources.label: NECT token on Berascan (EIP-1967 slots re-verified 2026-07-21)

mintAuthority.summary: NECT currently mints through collateral-vault branches, with Registry admission administered by a 4-of-7 Safe and a reviewed 3-day delay. Verified source proving every admissible branch/minter remains collateral-gated could not be recovered, and arbitrary minter admission is not independently proven. Economic cap semantics are unknown; the authored authorization power conservatively derives unbounded-unreconciled rather than retaining an unsupported favorable bound.

controls.label: NECT token / registered Beraborrow branch minters
controls.capDescription: Current Beraborrow Den branches are described as collateralized borrowing paths. The reviewed Registry owner can admit branches and change capacity, but verified source proving construction-enforced collateral checks for every admissible minter was not recovered. Root economic cap semantics are unknown, not a certified collateral bound.
controls.evidence: Beraborrow docs describe Dens depositing collateral to mint the overcollateralized stablecoin NECT (Liquity v2-style), with NECT token at 0x1cE0a25D13CE4d52071aE7e02Cf1F6606F4C79d3.

controls.label: Beraborrow Registry owner Safe (4/7) with 3-day timelock
controls.capDescription: 4-of-7 Beraborrow Safe owns the Registry contract (which controls branch/minter registration for NECT), subject to a 3-day timelock (259,200 seconds). NECT token has no owner() function and no OpenZeppelin Ownable/AccessControl, minting is whitelisted via TroveManagers/BorrowerOperations/DebtManager mappings controlled by the Registry.
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 22088792, NECT token (0x1ce0a25d) has no owner() (reverts), no Ownable/AccessControl in bytecode. Mint requires caller in TroveManagers (slot 8), BorrowerOperations (slot 11), or DebtManager (slot 12) mappings. Registry at 0x27393e8a owner() returned 0xce7d3fd53c0510325b3cebb96298522e6c538753 (Gnosis Safe L2, masterCopy 0x3e5c6364). RPC getOwners() returned 7 signers, getThreshold() returned 4. Registry timelock delay = 0x3f480 = 259200s (3 days). Safe modules/guard not confirmed via Safe API (Berachain Safe API endpoint unclear). Direct Berachain RPC reads at block 22089745: getOwners() returned 7 owners, getThreshold()=4, no modules, no guard, masterCopy GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0.

review.evidence: At Berachain block 22088792: NECT token has no Ownable/AccessControl in bytecode; owner() reverts; mint() reverts with 'Debt: Caller not BO/DM' (whitelisted contract minting). Registry at 0x27393e8a6f8f2e32b870903279999c820e984dc7 owned by 0xce7d3fd5 (4/7 Gnosis Safe L2, confirmed via RPC getOwners/getThreshold), timelock delay 3 days. Control is NOT renounced. Safe retains authority to add branch minters via Registry. Reclassification to immutable-user-collateralized is NOT appropriate. Berachain RPC reads at block 22089745 resolved the Registry owner Safe: getModulesPaginated returned no modules and the guard slot is zero, clearing the final modules/guards blocker. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: registered collateral branches mint NECT and the 4-of-7 Safe can add branches or raise capacity only through the enforced three-day registry timelock; no supervisor or attestor is identified. D14/D29 review on 2026-10-03 confirmed Registry owner() remains the reviewed Safe at Berachain block 26911487 (hash 0x3ec4636c9ee6291df05b8328f41013bb5776cfd8f1bdab90a8a109dca16d3304). Existing pinned reviews establish Registry-controlled branch/minter admission and token caller whitelisting, but do not prove whether admission is constrained to immutable collateral-checked branch implementations or can install an unrestricted borrower/debt-manager minter. Verified construction could not be recovered: Berascan returned HTTP 403, Sourcify had no full/partial/v2 match, Blockscout had no deployed record and Routescan did not support the chain. Neither deposit-only construction nor an arbitrary registration bypass is certified. Economic cap semantics are unknown, with no capSemanticsReview. The authored can-authorize control conservatively encodes an unbounded path, deriving unbounded-unreconciled with not-applicable reconciliation and no supervision; Safe authority is not D29 token governance.
